clauses.clause: ≥ 6 infected near the garage after the pickup, all from refuge doors (visible ≤ 3 m from the door); at most 3 pursue within 20 m, the rest wait 16 m back.
clauses.note: All20 fresh WebGPU low/high house-door inspection frames personally inspected. Residents emerge one-by-one through the actual open refuge front door; doorway/porch emergence is visible, rather than a street pop-in. Independent every-tick90s native traces retain10 admitted resident identities each tier, all first nonhidden0.9m from the same actual door (<=3m); this is the logical first-visible distance, not a frame-by-frame pixel onset measurement. Across all actual courier pursuers, maximum within20m is3 each tier. After residents walk to the holding ring, all waiting samples in final60–90s remain>=17.3128m low /17.4932m high from both courier and garage. Earlier approach distances6.55/6.82m are retained and not mislabeled as settled waiting. Player remains on ordinary pickup location, then empty input and damage protection solely for observation. Camera-only close inspection qualifies door presentation, not normal unlocked gameplay zoom.
